_about.log_dir: Folder that holds the career log (README.md, profile.md, roles/ and so on). Private: never a shared or published folder.
_about.resumes_dir: Folder where finished resumes are saved, one subfolder per target role. Often the log folder's parent.
_about.baseline_file: The current master resume (the baseline): a path relative to resumes_dir, or a full path. At first, the resume that got the user their current job; each new master the user approves replaces it.
_about.resume_name: File-name pattern for new resumes. MMDDYYYY or YYYY-MM-DD becomes the date, <Target> the target role.
_about.formats: Formats produced by default: any of docx, pdf, md, txt.
_about.last_review: Date career-review last ran (YYYY-MM-DD), or null.
